games.name: Innovation Inc. Spaceship

Further than any man or machine has ever been, flies the futuristic Innovation Inc Spaceship. Sent centuries ago to explore the secrets of the universe, this ship holds mysteries and dangers beyond imagination. Explore the ship, do experiments on each other, get infected, travel through space and survive on alien planets!
